messages:
ana: Seeing controller-manager leader flapping in sa-east starting ~04:10 UTC. GPU onboarding pods stuck Pending and apiserver returning 500s intermittently.

ops-bot: [ALERT] controller_manager_leader_flap count=7 in 8m (sa-east), apiserver_5xx_rate rising

vik: Any node-level signals? disk pressure, fd counts?

ana: (typo) ana: I mean: yes. Observed controlplane hosts hitting high inode usage and apiserver fd_count climbing to ~18k. Kernel dmesg shows "task:kube-apiserver invoked oom-killer" on one host earlier.

cory: Controller-manager log snippet around 04:11:

```
E0406 04:11:22.121 leaderelection.go:243] failed to renew lease: context deadline exceeded
I0406 04:11:22.122 controller_manager.go:156] leader election lost: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded
I0406 04:11:23.005 leaderelection.go:210] attempting to acquire lease kube-system/controller-manager...
```

ana: etcd metrics show WAL fsync p99 spikes to ~1.7s during same window and disk_iops spiking on cp-nvme-03.

vik: So chain looks like: disk pressure on cp node -> apiserver high fd / slow responses -> etcd WAL tail latency increases (due to contention) -> controller-manager lease renew misses -> leader churn -> controllers stall => GPU provisioning falls back.

ana: Snapshot of provisioning backlog at 04:13:

```
$ kubectl get pods -n gpu-onboard
NAME                     READY   STATUS    AGE
gpu-onboard-7xm2q        0/1     Pending   9m
gpu-onboard-9vplk        0/1     Pending   8m
```

cory: Quick mitigations I pushed: 1) cordoned cp-nvme-03, evicted non-critical system pods, freed some inode/disk pressure; 2) restarted kube-apiserver on cp-nvme-04 to drop fd usage; 3) temporarily bumped controller-manager leaseDuration=65s renewDeadline=45s in staging and will mirror to prod if stable.

ops-bot: action-created: infra-action-20260406-91 (owner: cory, ETA: 45m)

vik: Cost hit: during the ~22m degraded window we routed approx 140k tokens to hosted fallback. Billing estimate ~ $410 incremental. Tagging to infra-costs.

ana: Proposed follow-ups:
- ana: add an alert for apiserver_fd_count > 15k for 2m to page oncall
- vik: add preflight check for disk inode usage before kernel or package updates on controlplane nodes
- cory: write small runbook: "apiserver fd/disk pressure -> etcd tail latency -> controller lease churn" with commands to detect orphaned leases, cordon, evict, and quick disk cleanup steps

cory: I'm going to run the staged parameter change in prod in 20m if the cluster stays stable and finish cleanup on the cordoned node.

ana: Quick detection commands I used: 
```
ss -s | grep TIME-WAIT && lsof -p $(pgrep kube-apiserver) | wc -l
kubectl -n kube-system get lease -o wide | grep controller-manager
kubectl get pods -n gpu-onboard -o wide
```

vik: Also recommend we add a cheap client-side retry with jitter for GPU provisioning controller->api calls so short leader blips don't immediately cause fallback. Keep retry budget small to avoid amplifying latency.

ops-bot: incident-created: INC-20260406-91 (severity: medium). Runbook link placeholder: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/apiserver-fd-disk-pressure-lease-churn

ana: Will post a quick update in 30m after prod parameter rollout. Thanks all :thumbsup:
